Auras.Name: Aura reminders
Auras.Hint: Remind when a hostile creature starts or ends its turn within range of a trait such as Shifting Form.

OwnTurn.Name: Own-turn reminders
OwnTurn.Hint: Remind about traits that trigger at the start or end of the monster's own turn.

OnKill.Name: On-kill reminders
OnKill.Hint: Remind about traits such as Soul Devourer when a creature drops to 0 hit points during the monster's turn.

OnDamaged.Name: When-damaged reminders
OnDamaged.Hint: Remind about traits that trigger when the monster takes damage.

Reactions.Name: Reaction reminders
Reactions.Hint: Remind when a monster's reaction could be used: targeted by an attack, an attack misses it, hit in melee, takes damage, or a creature nearby dies or is healed. Skipped when the monster has already used its reaction (Black Flag QOL's Reaction Used effect), has no uses left, or is dead.

TRAITREM.Title: Trait reminder
TRAITREM.Aura: {creature} starts its turn within {range} ft of {holder}
TRAITREM.AuraEnd: {creature} ends its turn within {range} ft of {holder}
